text_block_list.text: —One day, at Tamamo Cross's family home.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tama-neene. "That matter"
ya talked about back in summer, is it settled now?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What... what was 'that story' about again?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
They were arguin' 'bout who's faster between
Tama-nee-nee and Oguri Cap.
Nee-nee won, though...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that? Course it's settled.
With the other Umamusume too. Here, lemme tell ya all about it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Titled: The fairy tale, "Tamamo Cross and
the Three Monster Siblings"!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Big sis Tama, tell me, tell me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Splish-splash, bobbing along~♪ The moment I landed on Takarazuka Island in my little boat... the ravenous monster Inari One attacked!"

text_block_list.name: Kaiju Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Woof woof! Give me inari sushi, woof!
If you don't, I'll punish you, woof!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Except, wouldn't ya know it, I turned the tables on 'em!
I fed 'em a boatload of takoyaki, and they quieted right down, lickety-split.

text_block_list.name: Kaiju Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh, takoyaki ain't half bad either,
you tell 'em...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
When I set off on another journey, the monster
Oguri Cap appeared! Unbelievably, she attacked me
across three islands: Aki-Ten Island, JC Island, and Arima Island~!

text_block_list.name: Monster Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama... I want to eat you.
I'm starving, please!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't jokin'!
No way was I gonna get eaten!
And so, as a result of our head-to-head clash...

text_block_list.name: Monster Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Is this inside Tama's stomach?
I see... So I ended up being eaten instead...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri wasn't the only one who attacked on Arima Island, ya know!
Big Mama Super Creek was there too!

text_block_list.name: Giant Mother Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Right away, Tama-chan♪
Time to beat you to a pulp, widdle baby~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Like hell it would! When I went 'round and 'round Arima Island, she followed along, but... by the end, she was totally staggering and worn out~."

text_block_list.name: Giant Mother Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fuehh~, Tama-chan's in her rebellious phase~.
Mommy's sowwy for being a bad mama~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
An' that's how not a single soul could beat me this year!
And they all lived happily ever after!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's why you can go ahead and brag!
The one who's stronger than Oguri,
stronger than Inari, stronger than Creek—is Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Wow, big sis, that's so so cool!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: So, what happened to the three who got defeated?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, those three who lost, ya see.
They became my retainers and started followin' me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's why they follow along just like
a bunch of ducklings. It's pretty adorable.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wait, hey! I went out of my way to come visit you, and this is how you introduce me?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it is true that I couldn't beat Tama, but...
Hello, I'm Oguri Cap. ...Got that?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, so cute~~~. Goodness,
it just makes me want to squeeze you tight~♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, Oguri Cap, Inari One,
and Super Creek?! Hey, hey, does this mean?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"She kept goin' on about how she just had to see the little ones,
so I brought 'er along."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Now, go on and play to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap...! To be honest...
I kinda think Oguri's pretty amazing too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see, thank you... But if I've been
able to grow stronger like this, it's all thanks to Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Um... Excuse me... Creek-san...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, you want a hug~? Of course
you can~, up we go, up in the air~!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, you said you had a favor to ask,
so I wondered what it was, but doing service like this?
I've gotta give you credit, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, thanks a bunch, you three!
The little ones were over the moon thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"If it's come to this, you'll just have to come back next year and the year after.
As long as I keep winning, you'll listen to me, right?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: G-Get outta here, you idiot! As if I'd let that happen!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama, I have no intention of losing either.
However...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It might be nice to come back here to play again.
Fufufu.
And so, having achieved complete victory over Oguri Cap, Inari One, and Super Creek, Tamamo Cross—

I brought my rivals from Tracen Academy
to meet my beloved little brother and sister,
and let them all play together.
